test_gtn_equal: test two gtn graphs for equality comparing nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_gtn_isomorphic: test two gtn graphs for structural isomorphism ignoring node ordering
test_gtn_loadtxt: test loading a gtn graph from a text file and verify equality
test_gtn_savetxt: test saving a gtn graph to a text file and verify output format
test_gtn_loadsave: test saving and loading a gtn graph to a binary file and verify equality
